assumptions_challenged: That MISEV2023 alone is sufficient to justify the specific Stage-1 deliverables, their acceptance criteria, and the proposed timeline without program-specific data.

That program-specific CMC artifacts (MCB/WCB certificates, GMP-like batch records, validated orthogonal and intact-EV assay validation reports, stability/potency reproducibility data, and formulation/device compatibility studies) have already been produced or can be produced on the proposed schedule.
That the orthogonal QC panel and intact-EV assays described will have fit-for-purpose validation characteristics (LLOQ, specificity, precision) without empirical validation reports.
That linkage between a stability-indicating potency assay and an in vivo PD endpoint has been established or is straightforward to establish without presenting correlation data.
That rodent intranasal biodistribution data can be bridged to larger species for intact-EV CNS exposure absent validated intact-EV analytics and cross-species controls.
falsification_conditions: Provide Master Cell Bank (MCB) and Working Cell Bank (WCB) characterization reports and certificates demonstrating identity, absence of adventitious agents, and documented cell-line provenance.

Supply three representative GMP-like batch manufacturing records and release datasets with defined in-process controls and outcomes, plus comparability reports showing analytical side-by-side results across scales.

Deliver complete validation reports for the orthogonal QC panel and for intact-EV assays (including methods, LLOQ, specificity, precision, accuracy, and acceptance criteria) demonstrating fit-for-purpose performance.

Provide stability study reports where the stability-indicating potency assay is applied across timepoints and lots, with predefined specification limits and evidence of reproducible potency over stability conditions.
Provide correlation data linking the potency assay readout to a relevant in vivo PD endpoint (statistical correlation, study design, raw data) demonstrating biological relevance.

Provide formulation and device compatibility studies (bench and ex vivo recovery experiments and in-use simulation) showing intact-EV recovery and preserved assay signals after formulation, filling, storage, and dosing.

Present GLP or otherwise well-controlled cross-species intranasal biodistribution data with methods that distinguish intact EVs from free/non-vesicular signal (using validated intact-EV assays and appropriate controls).
strongest_objection: The proposed Stage-1 CMC/analytics package and timeline rest on program-specific data and capabilities that are not present in the supplied evidence set (only MISEV2023). Therefore the conclusion that the program is ready to compare lots, advance intranasal bridging studies, or meet regulator expectations is unsupported; the single guideline does not demonstrate that the specific MCB/WCB documents, validated intact-EV/orthogonal assays, GMP-like batch comparability, stability-indicating potency validation linked to PD, and formulation/device compatibility data either exist or are sufficient.
